posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Fittipaldo says the Steelers may be moving forward with a new right side of their offensive line: “There were indications during the open media viewing window at Wednesday’s practice the Steelers are preparing to move forward with Brock Hoffman at right guard and rookie No. 1 pick Max Iheanachor at right tackle.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Cam Heyward on Joe Burrow: “He keeps his eyes downfield, he's able to extend plays. He's almost like a magician with the ball. He knows how to deliver big plays to his wide receivers. He gives them a chance. Ja'Marr and Tee, they do a great job just asking for the ball and Joe's like, I'm going to get you the ball. It's always special to play against Joe because he is going stretch you with his feet. He can run downhill if he wants to, but he's more likely going to extend the play, try to look down at where his receivers are.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Cam Heyward has a lot of respect for the Bengals RB Chase Brown: “It's him just being explosive. Hitting that gap has really benefited him in the past. Early in the season, really got to stress tackling. I thought we got rid of a lot of missed tackles, but the ones we did have led to big gains. So that can always improve. A lot of respect for him going downhill, using his offhand for a stiff arm. It's just a real complementary thing to their passing game because if you have to guard both ways and have to play run and pass, you're in for a long day.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Cam Heyward on the Bengals running game: “I think with Chase and Perine, they do a great job of having that one-two punch. They play downhill and they're just looking for a crease and they get started. It's about guys staying in their gaps, getting off blocks, being physical at the point of attack, not guessing. I think sometimes we get to a point where we try to do too much, and I'm guilty of that as well. But looking forward to hitting that challenge for real now.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Cam Heyward on the Bengals: “They're 2-0, got off to a good start. Played some quality opponents in Tampa Bay and Houston. They're high-flying. They have really good receivers, really good running back, heck of a quarterback. A lot of respect on their offensive side of the ball. And their defense has played really well as of late. Looking forward to the challenge.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Kaboly believes there is no chance in hell the Steelers will bench Aaron Rodgers: “I can’t wrap my head around a scenario where McCarthy goes to Rodgers during his retirement tour and tells him to have a seat. Maybe a Week 17 or 18 game if they are like 5-11 at the time. Other than that, Rodgers will start the entire season.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Equanimeous St. Brown thinks Aaron Rodgers should call his own plays: “It might be time for Aaron to start calling his own plays. I can’t confirm or deny, but being in that huddle a few times, it seemed like Aaron called his own plays, and they worked, I wanna say 90 percent of the time. I can’t confirm because he has a headset in. But when he’s getting the play call, sometimes you could just tell he called his own play. And I know he changed the play sometimes because when I’m not in the game, and I’m next to one of the coaches, and I can hear the play call, and we look at the formation, and it’s not the formation that was called. So, he does change the play sometimes. I don’t know if he’s doing that with the Steelers. He might need to get back to that.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Russell Wilson says the Steelers offense looked stale: I think their offense looked stale. The Pittsburgh Steelers’ offense, no motions, there’s no shifts. That’s what Aaron’s done all these years. The difference I think, though, when you go back to the time where Aaron Rodgers was in Green Bay, he was so used to Jordy Nelson. He was so used to Cobb, Davante Adams. They had the system so deep and so enriched with their thoughts and ideas. And I think that it takes some time when you have a new head coach, not really new to Aaron but new to the whole organization. I think that’s where they’ve gotta figure out, ‘How do we marry up what we used to do back in the day with Aaron to what we need to do today?’ I think that’s the issue in Pittsburgh.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Former Steeler Bryant McFadden believes the Bengals will beat the Steelers: “I can’t put my faith, my trust, my money in the Pittsburgh Steelers until I see otherwise. Their offense hasn’t showed up. If it wasn’t for that T.J. Watt touchdown, they might have lost that Atlanta game, because their offense wasn’t doing anything. And we’ve seen a different Cincinnati Bengals defensive unit, on all three levels. I think it’s going to be too much for Pittsburgh. Give me Cincy.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Ladd McConkey is officially active.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Welcome back, TreVeyon Henderson.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: The Packers have ruled out WR Jayden Reed (neck) and RT Zach Bako-Bewele (knee).

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: 49ers RB Kaelon Black (groin) is expected to go on Sunday after being limited some this week, sources say. Coach Kyle Shanahan told reporters this week it was minor.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Ravens pass-rusher Trey Hendrickson, who broke a finger into several pieces this week, is slated to play on Sunday with cast on his hand, sources say.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Chiefs star DT Chris Jones, who has dealt with a calf injury, should be good to go for tonight’s game, sources say.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Chargers WR Ladd McConkey, dealing with a cracked rib, practiced Friday and has improved more steadily than anticipated. The team did not elevate a WR and he’s pushing to play, sources say.

There is optimism that he can go today, barring a setback.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: The Falcons are getting healthy, with G Chris Lindstrom (concussion) clearing the protocol and CB AJ Terrell (shoulder) also expected to play, sources say.

posts.author: CBS Sports
posts.text: NFL Week 2 injury report: Puka Nacua, Joe Burrow questionable, Zay Flowers, Michael Pittman, Kyler Murray out - CBS Sports

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Injury news:
— Patriots CB Carlton Davis III has been downgraded to out vs the Steelers.
— Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) won’t practice today and will be questionable for MNF.
— Packers DT Javon Hargrave (knee/concussion) downgraded to out, but edge Lukas Van Ness has cleared concussion protocol.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Jets rookie WR Omar Cooper Jr. is going to be placed on Injured Reserve, sources say, giving him four weeks to recover from his ankle sprain. He’ll be designated to return and should be back shortly.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Deshaun Watson and Baker Mayfield meet on Sunday in Tampa for the first time since one of the biggest trades, and wildest weeks, in NFL history. 

An in-depth look at how it happened, and the fallout for all involved, in my latest dispatch at The Sweep:

tompelissero.substack.com/p/week-2-ins...

posts.text: 2026 NFL Week 2 Injury Report: Zay Flowers and Michael Pittman Jr. out, update on Puka Nacua - NBC Sports

posts.author: NFL.com
posts.text: NFL Week 2 injury report: Player statuses for all 16 games - NFL.com

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Jets WR Omar Cooper Jr. is believed to have suffered a high ankle sprain in today’s win over Tennessee, sources say. 

X-rays were negative. Cooper, the first-round pick, will have an MRI on Monday to determine the extent of the injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Myles Garrett is now set to miss games against the Giants, Broncos, Eagles and Bills. L.A. hosts the Cardinals in Week 6.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Rams star Myles Garrett will undergo arthroscopic surgery on his ailing knee and is headed to injured reserve, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Garrett has been dealing with lower-leg pain and wasn’t himself in Thursday’s opener. The hope is he’s back in four weeks.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald says the team got good news on Sam Darnold, who underwent tests that ruled out a hip fracture. Still more tests to come. But Macdonald sounded upbeat about the initial prognosis.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Baker Mayfield’s new contract with the Bucs got him to the $55 million benchmark he wanted. It also prevented a scenario where Tampa Bay would have to carry a nonnegotiable cap number of nearly $80 million for its QB next season.

More in The Sweep: tompelissero.substack.com/p/week-1-not...

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Drake Maye wasn’t the only QB hurting in the Super Bowl. Sam Darnold spent most of the playoffs in a rehab progression for an external oblique strain as the Seahawks made a championship run.

More ahead of tonight’s rematch in a free column at The Sweep: tompelissero.substack.com/p/week-1-not...

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text: Sources: The #Seahawks are signing veteran QB Drew Lock, bringing him back to Seattle for a second stint. He will backup Sam Darnold.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text:
Sources: Colorado QB Shedeur Sanders is scheduled to visit the #Raiders early next week. 

Las Vegas holds the No. 6 pick in the draft. They have been doing work on QBs and have other QB prospects also coming into their building.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text: Spoke with an NFL assistant GM about Alabama QB Jalen Milroe: “He’s one of the most intriguing guys in the entire draft. There’s a narrative that he’s just a running quarterback, but that’s way off...

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text:
Former #Bucs OC Byron Leftwich is back in coaching as he is joining Deion Sanders’ staff at Colorado.

Leftwich interviewed for multiple NFL jobs this past cycle (Pats HC, Seahawks OC) but now makes the move to college.

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text: #Bears GM Ryan Poles, via team statement: “This morning, after meeting with George and Kevin, we informed Matt of our decision to move in a different direction with the leadership of our football team and the head coaching position…”

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text:
Matt Eberflus at 9:30a: “I’m confident I’ll be prepping for SF and coaching this team.”

Matt Eberflus at noon: FIRED.

(Why would the #Bears let that man address reporters, knowing he wouldn’t make it thru the week, let alone the day?)

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text: Will this game be over before I have to leave for Cincinnati on Saturday 🫠

posts.text: Ok, finally dipping my toe in these waters. I realllllly hope this is way less of a negative cesspool than X!
